suppress.notes: False positive: sikulix2tigervnc is a Java library for screen recording, NOT the TigerVNC VNC server/client. These CVEs apply to the native TigerVNC desktop application, not this Java wrapper library.
xmlrpc 3.1.3 is abandonware (last release 2013). Used by testlink-java-api. Consider replacing testlink-java-api or implementing custom XML-RPC client. JIRA: Evaluate replacement by Q1 2026

CVE-2023-33202 affects BouncyCastle jdk15on. Migration to jdk18on requires sikulix2tigervnc update. sikulix2tigervnc has no update available. Risk accepted: Limited impact in zahori-framework context.
commons-configuration2 2.1.1 comes from testlink-java-api. CVE-2024-29131/29133 are OGNL injection vulnerabilities. Risk mitigated: TestLink integration is isolated, no user input processed.

CVE-2025-55163, CVE-2025-58056, CVE-2025-58057 affect Netty 4.1.118. Netty is managed by Spring Boot BOM. Awaiting Spring Boot 3.4.x patch. Risk mitigated: Framework does not expose memcache/mqtt protocols.
CVE-2025-27820 affects httpclient5 5.4.1. SSRF vulnerability. Risk mitigated: Framework validates all URLs before requests. Awaiting httpclient5 5.4.2+ with fix.
Multiple CVEs affect Tomcat 10.1.34 (embedded via Spring Boot 3.4.1). Awaiting Spring Boot 3.4.2+ with Tomcat update to 10.1.35+. Risk: Several HIGH/CRITICAL CVEs - prioritize Spring Boot upgrade.
CVE-2025-48924 affects commons-lang3 3.17.0. Awaiting commons-lang3 3.18.0 with fix.
CVE-2025-31672 affects Apache POI 5.3.0. XXE vulnerability. Risk mitigated: Framework only processes trusted Excel files. Awaiting POI 5.4.0 with fix.
False positive: angus-activation is NOT angus-mail. CVE-2025-7962 applies to angus-mail, not angus-activation.
